verdict.rationale: Fellow is an AI meeting-notes product with its own assistant ("Ask Fellow"), so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence only documents Fellow acting as an MCP server that outside chatbots like Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor connect to. That is a different role and earns no credit here, and nothing shows Fellow consuming third-party MCP servers or their tools.
